rationale: C04 is a concrete drafting template for the child. Both proclamations concern the identical annual observance, cite the same joint resolution, use the same recital-to-operative structure, and share an almost verbatim two-sentence operative passage with only the year, date, and a minor wording change. C25 also supplies closely related language about year-round assistance, economic independence, and active participation, while C17 shares the recurring observance machinery but not the child's distinctive closing language as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the Congress, by a joint resolution approved August 11, 1945 (59 Stat. 530), designated the first week in October of each year as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the Congress, by a joint resolution approved August 11, 1945 (59 Stat. 530), designated the first week in October of each year as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week

shared_material.child_excerpt: do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 4, 1959, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 6, 1957, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week
shared_material.explanation: The operative call is copied essentially verbatim with the annual date updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I also urge our citizens to remember, throughout the year, that by their interest and efforts many handicapped persons can be assisted to economic independence and active participation in a productive way of life.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I also urge our citizens to remember, throughout the year, that by their interest and efforts many handicapped persons can be assisted to economic Independence and active participation in our productive way of life.
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive closing sentence is nearly verbatim; the child changes only “our productive way of life” to “a productive way of life.”
